name: Llama-v3.2-3B-Instruct-SSD
headline: State-of-the-art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks, with Self Speculative Decoding offering faster token rates.
description: Llama 3 is a family of LLMs. The model is quantized to w4a16 (4-bit weights and 16-bit activations) and part of the model is quantized to w8a16 (8-bit weights and 16-bit activations) making it suitable for on-device deployment. This variant uses Self Speculative Decoding (SSD), inference acceleration solution that achieves on-target speed up with guaranteed output accuracy identical to the base model. Choose this variant over llama_v3_2_3b_instruct for faster token generation on supported devices.

technical_details.string_value: Rate of response generation after the first response token.

Single-model LLM inference acceleration solution that achieves on-target speed up with guaranteed output accuracy identical to the base model. Choose this variant over llama_v3_2_3b_instruct for faster token generation on supported devices.

Time To First Token is the time it takes to generate the first response token. This is expressed as a range because it varies based on the length of the prompt. The lower bound is for a short prompt (up to 128 tokens, i.e., one iteration of the prompt processor) and the upper bound is for a prompt using the full context length (4096 tokens).
